messages:
Ravi (partnerships): Quick sync to align cloud listing + HW partner optimizations + SI deployment notes. Goal: one minimal public listing + notes for "optimized instance" tile. Who can own assets + announcement timing?
Marta (marketplace PM): I'll own the listing metadata. Need SKU names, trial callout, and vendor-facing manifest.
Ken (hardware-partner): We can provide an "Optimized on Inferentia" badge for the AWS tile and a short note about recommended instance families. Will share logo SVG and wording.
Aisha (SI): For system integrators we need a separate integration note that we can include in the listing details: quickstart for managed installs + contact for professional services. I'll draft.
Sam (legal): Reminder: any joint announcement must clear legal; also need logo usage terms from hardware partner before publishing. Ken, can you send the asset license?
Ken (hardware-partner): Sending logo + license now to marketplace-support@redwood.ai. License allows co-marketing with attribution.
Marta (marketplace PM): Draft SKU set: redwood-payg, redwood-dedicated, redwood-private. Trial: "14-day trial; billing begins after trial unless canceled." Is that final?
Ravi (partnerships): Yes keep trial uniform across clouds. Also plan announcement window: don't publicize joint HW badge until vendor listing passes sandbox tests.
Aisha (SI): For SI note I'll include contact: si-partners@redwood.ai and a short line: "Managed deployment and integration services available via certified partners."
Marta (marketplace PM): Vendor manifest (minimal) for reviewers:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
image: registry.redwood/release:marketplace
health_check: /healthz
recommended_instance_families: [c6i, inf1]
```
We'll keep instance families optional.
DevOps-bot: Marketplace checklist: SKU draft true; logo_assets received true; manifest_uploaded true; legal_clearance pending.
Sam (legal): I'll review logo usage and the one-line co-marketing clause. Also will draft the short privacy footnote for EU listings: "Data processed per EU-region controls."
Ravi (partnerships): Marketing ask: coordinate press/announcement date with vendor PMs. Do not schedule before sandbox approval. I'll handle PM outreach.
Ken (hardware-partner): Confirmed — we'll hold joint blog/announce until marketplace publish go-live.
Marta (marketplace PM): Action items: I will push metadata + manifest to shared drive by EOD PT. Ravi: coordinate vendor PM timing. Sam: legal check on assets. Aisha: SI blurb uploaded by tomorrow.
Ravi (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Ping here when uploads done and I'll schedule the vendor go/no-go call. :rocket:
